email.body1:
Kathleen, saw Lilt shipped its MCP server and an Adobe Experience Manager connector, deepening the agentic automation push.

Launches like that usually open more in-market accounts than a regional team can cover, and that is where good-fit deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lilt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: a quick teardown of your outbound
email.body2:
Kathleen, quick follow-up for Lilt.

Selling enterprise localization usually means long buying groups and slow follow-up, and most reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations. Tightening that motion is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your region's enterprise targets.
email.body3:
Kathleen, last bit of proof for Lilt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lilt's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kathleen, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a product launch there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise localization motion? I will tailor it to Lilt either way.
